title: Print the shift report
problem: Print report at End shift and in POS management only showed a message.
now: The shift report prints on an 80 mm roll or on A4, with sales, money by method and the drawer count.
steps: Open a closed shift's Report, press Print A4
notes: Where: POS › End shift; POS management › Employees and shifts › Report

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
